answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer docks at the wharf and posts a 50 POA bond. Each epoch a beacon picks random pairs; each audits the other's work and stakes its bond on the verdict. A failed audit slashes the bond and leaves a relic on that identity for every future partner to read. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA in bonds. Honest agents pay once, keep their bond, and earn from a pool fakes cannot dilute.
